---1.) LNS Relationship Exposure -> Customer Level
---2.) LNS Due for the Month -> Customer Level


---1.) LNS Relationship Exposure -> Customer Level
DECLARE @date date, 
@customerid varchar(50)

SET @date = '2023-01-27'
SET @customerid  = 'R00117492'
BEGIN
WITH Tally AS (
    SELECT 
    A.ORGKEY, C.ACID, D.FORACID, A.BANK_ID, B.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE, D.SOL_ID, D.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE, D.SCHM_CODE, D.SCHM_TYPE
    ,CASE WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and D.ACCT_CLS_DATE <= getdate() and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('CAA','SBA','TDA') THEN 'Closed' 
        WHEN E.PAYOFF_FLG = 'Y' and E.PAYOFF_DATE <= GETDATE() and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('LAA','CLA') THEN 'Closed' 
        WHEN E.PAYOFF_FLG = 'N' and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('LAA','CLA') THEN 'Active' 
        WHEN E.PAYOFF_FLG = 'Y' and E.PAYOFF_DATE > GETDATE() and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('LAA','CLA') THEN 'Active'
        END as AccountStatus
    ,C.EOD_DATE, C.END_EOD_DATE, C.TRAN_DATE_BAL
        FROM (SELECT * FROM busc.CRM_ACCOUNTS WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) A
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) B ON B.CUST_ID = A.CORE_CUST_ID AND B.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.LNS_EODACCTBAL WHERE isActive = 1) C ON C.ACID = B.ACID AND C.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) D ON D.ACID = B.ACID AND D.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.LNS_LAACCTMAST WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) E ON E.ACID = B.ACID AND E.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
)
SELECT * FROM Tally WHERE ORGKEY = @customerid AND EOD_DATE <= @date AND END_EOD_DATE >= @date
END
 ---AND DEL_FLG != 'Y'
SELECT A.ORGKEY, SUM(A.TRAN_DATE_BAL) 
    FROM Tally A
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE WHERE isLatest = 1 AND VAR_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' AND RATECODE = 'REV' AND RTLIST_DATE = @date) B ON B.FXD_CRNCY_CODE = A.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AND B.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
    WHERE A.SCHM_CODE NOT LIKE '09%'--- AND (A.AccountStatus != 'Closed' OR A.AccountStatus IS NULL)
    AND A.ORGKEY = @customerid AND A.EOD_DATE <= @date AND A.END_EOD_DATE >= @date
    GROUP BY ORGKEY
END


SELECT * FROM Tally WHERE ORGKEY = @customerid AND EOD_DATE <= @date AND END_EOD_DATE <= @date




---2.) LNS Due for the Month -> Customer Level
DECLARE @date date, 
@customerid varchar(50)

SET @date = '2023-01-27'
SET @customerid  = 'R00327988'
BEGIN
WITH Tally AS (
    SELECT 
    A.ORGKEY, C.ACID, D.FORACID, A.BANK_ID, B.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE, D.SOL_ID, D.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE, D.SCHM_CODE, D.SCHM_TYPE
    ,CASE WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and D.ACCT_CLS_DATE <= getdate() and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('CAA','SBA','TDA') THEN 'Closed' 
        WHEN E.PAYOFF_FLG = 'Y' and E.PAYOFF_DATE <= GETDATE() and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('LAA','CLA') THEN 'Closed' 
        WHEN E.PAYOFF_FLG = 'N' and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('LAA','CLA') THEN 'Active' 
        WHEN E.PAYOFF_FLG = 'Y' and E.PAYOFF_DATE > GETDATE() and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('LAA','CLA') THEN 'Active'
        END as AccountStatus
    ,C.DMD_EFF_DATE, C.DMD_FLOW_ID, C.DMD_AMT
        FROM (SELECT * FROM busc.CRM_ACCOUNTS WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) A
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) B ON B.CUST_ID = A.CORE_CUST_ID AND B.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.LNS_LADMD WHERE isActive = 1 AND DMD_FLOW_ID IN ('PRDEM', 'INDEM')) C ON C.ACID = B.ACID AND C.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) D ON D.ACID = B.ACID AND D.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.LNS_LAACCTMAST WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) E ON E.ACID = B.ACID AND E.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
)
,Tally_Penal AS (
    SELECT 
    A.ORGKEY, C.ACID, D.FORACID, A.BANK_ID, B.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE, D.SOL_ID, D.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE, D.SCHM_CODE, D.SCHM_TYPE
    ,CASE WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and D.ACCT_CLS_DATE <= getdate() and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('CAA','SBA','TDA') THEN 'Closed' 
        WHEN E.PAYOFF_FLG = 'Y' and E.PAYOFF_DATE <= GETDATE() and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('LAA','CLA') THEN 'Closed' 
        WHEN E.PAYOFF_FLG = 'N' and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('LAA','CLA') THEN 'Active' 
        WHEN E.PAYOFF_FLG = 'Y' and E.PAYOFF_DATE > GETDATE() and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('LAA','CLA') THEN 'Active'
        END as AccountStatus
    ,C.DMD_EFF_DATE, C.DMD_FLOW_ID, C.DMD_AMT
        FROM (SELECT * FROM busc.CRM_ACCOUNTS WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) A
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) B ON B.CUST_ID = A.CORE_CUST_ID AND B.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.LNS_LAPENALDMD WHERE isActive = 1 AND DMD_FLOW_ID IN ('APDEM')) C ON C.ACID = B.ACID AND C.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) D ON D.ACID = B.ACID AND D.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.LNS_LAACCTMAST WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) E ON E.ACID = B.ACID AND E.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
)
SELECT ORGKEY, SUM(DMD_AMT) FROM
    (SELECT * FROM Tally WHERE ORGKEY = @customerid AND DMD_EFF_DATE <= @date AND DATEADD(month, 1, DMD_EFF_DATE) >= @date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM Tally_Penal WHERE ORGKEY = @customerid AND DMD_EFF_DATE <= @date AND DATEADD(month, 1, DMD_EFF_DATE) >= @date) A
    GROUP BY ORGKEY
END


SELECT * FROM Tally WHERE ORGKEY = @customerid AND DMD_EFF_DATE <= @date AND DATEADD(month, 1, DMD_EFF_DATE) >= @date
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM Tally_Penal WHERE ORGKEY = @customerid AND DMD_EFF_DATE <= @date AND DATEADD(month, 1, DMD_EFF_DATE) >= @date
END
